newsitem.title: UK: UK shares open firmer on Dow rally, bid activity.
newsitem.headline: UK shares open firmer on Dow rally, bid activity.

text.p: UK shares were given a double boost on Friday, pushing higher at the opening bell after Wall Street's 83-point surge overnight and news of continuing bid activity in the financial services sector.
Provided the Dow, which has risen nearly 170 points over the past two days, remains steady, the FTSE is expected to test its all-time highs in the next few sessions, dealers said.
"There is still room for a setback on Wall Street but sentiment seems to favour a re-test of the highs," the head of sales and trading at a major investment bank said.
The FTSE 100 was up 24.5 points at 4,252.9 by 0835 GMT.
